data.name: Bakhtavar
data.gender_notes: Bakhtavar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name of Persian origin, Bakhtavar means 'Lord of Fortune' or 'Master of Good Fortune'. This name symbolizes the power of Allah in granting good fortune and success in life. The name Bakhtavar carries the meaning “Lord of Fortune” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bakhtavar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's blessings and mercy.
data.etymology: Bakhtavar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bakhtavar total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bakhtavar is deeply rooted in Persian culture and literature. In Persian mythology, Bakhtiari people, who are a tribe originating from the Bakhtiari lands, are believed to be descended from a holy figure named Bakhtavar. He is remembered as a brave ruler, protector of his people, and bringer of prosperity. This is reflected in the cultural significance of the name, which connotes power, strength, and luck.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Bakhtavar is a reminder of Allah's ultimate power and control over all aspects of life. The fortune and success we experience are not our own doing, but a mercy and blessing from Allah. The name encourages us to turn to Him in times of adversity and gratitude in times of prosperity, recognizing that all good things come from Allah and that He alone is the true Master of Fortune.
